scope: ABBA evaluation of bulk direct-read swap restoration experiment on authored 192 MB prepared raster
decision: Rejected as unproven speed optimization; both production changes reverted, mixed small/bulk regression retained
experiment: ReadStream bypasses staging buffer when empty and caller output at least 64 KiB; each file read remains capped at 64 KiB with BLAKE3 and cancellation checks
Raster payload sample read chunks increased from 16 KiB to 256 KiB
finding: Baseline restore p50 240.694 and 240.125 ms; experimental 241.079 and 236.704 ms. No consistent useful reduction established; whole-path total p50 also overlaps.
limitations: Dev workspace opt-level=1, external dependencies opt-level=3; not a release performance qualification
One authored low-entropy source; warm local disk
15 measured iterations/run plus three warmups; per-run quantiles only
Reference vectors and identity scans outside timing/managed budget still affect memory/cache traffic
No claim of universal gain or absence of regressions on every backend/storage device
Physical HDR, physical slow disk, OS-wide pressure and NVIDIA remain unqualified
